findings.rule_broken: No wireless deep read. Bulk memory leaves a Lattice only through the mastoid port at 4 Mb/s, and one recorded hour is 360 MB - twelve minutes of unbroken cable.
findings.problem: Lot 4417 is twenty-four recorded hours (8,640 MB), which at the port's fixed 4 Mb/s rate requires four hours and forty-eight minutes of unbroken cable (24 hours x 12 minutes/hour). The draft has the entire lot cross the mastoid lead in twenty minutes, roughly fourteen times faster than the port's stated bandwidth allows - effectively a wireless-deep-read-speed transfer over a wired link, and it erases the 'measurable and stateable length of time' the theft/consent rule depends on.
findings.fix: Change the duration to four hours and forty-eight minutes, or reduce the amount read in this sitting to match a twenty-minute session (roughly 600 MB, under two recorded hours).
